what_it_is: Robot Poncots Sun (Japan) save made on the MiSTer Gameboy core, posted alongside the USA one in an openFPGA-GBC HuC-3 RTC issue; in-game state not described. Extracted from Robopon_MiSTer_SAVE.zip.
note: HuC-3 (has RTC footer, so the regular HuC-3 release, not the HuC-1 Comic Bom Bom edition; exact No-Intro name assumed). 33280 = 32768 + 512-byte footer: 8499d065 (LE u32 1708169604 = 2024-02-17 11:33:24 UTC) then 198f0040 0000, rest 0xFF.
